name.zh: 把掷出的结果分配给行动

summary.zh: 骰子先告诉你这回合有什么，再由你决定把它们用在哪里。
summary.en: Roll first, then decide where each available result will do the most good.

rules.zh: 每回合先掷出一组结果，再由玩家分配给可接受的行动或目标。行动可能要求特定点数、奇偶或效果类型；可用结果有限，玩家要把不理想的骰子也安排出用途。
rules.en: Roll a pool before assigning results to eligible actions or targets. Requirements may involve numbers, parity or effect types; a limited pool makes even awkward results worth considering.

loop.zh: 查看能用的槽位或目标

loop.en: Resolve and prepare the next roll

decisions.zh: 把高点数给大伤害，还是留给最低点数有要求的辅助行动？
decisions.en: Spend a high roll on damage or reserve it for a demanding utility slot?

decisions.zh: 先重掷坏结果，还是接受它并利用一个有代价的效果？
decisions.en: Reroll an awkward result or use a costly effect it enables?

effect.zh: 重掷和改面越多，随机性越低，但计算选择会增多。
effect.en: More rerolls and conversions reduce randomness while increasing calculation.

effect.zh: 多个行动争用同一类结果时，分配才会产生取舍。
effect.en: Trade-offs appear when multiple actions compete for the same kind of result.

implementation.zh: 骰子被放进装备的槽位来发动效果，槽位会要求偶数、最低点数或最高点数。
implementation.en: Dice activate equipment slots with conditions such as even values, minimums or maximums.

observation.zh: 机制图：装备上明确写着偶数、最小四与最大三等骰子条件，底部是待分配骰子。
observation.en: Mechanic view: equipment shows even, minimum-four and maximum-three requirements, with unassigned dice below.

implementation.zh: 骰面提供净化或腐化等效果，玩家选择目标；净化与腐化作用在自己或敌人身上会产生不同后果。
implementation.en: Dice supply effects such as Purification and Corruption; choosing self or enemy as target changes their consequences.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：战斗角色、状态图标与待分配的骰子同屏显示。
observation.en: System reference: Combatants, status icons and available dice share the screen. See the linked text source for the rules.

contrast.zh: 《骰子地下城》侧重数字与装备槽位的匹配；《Astrea》侧重效果种类及其目标，不是所有骰子构筑都靠点数大小。
contrast.en: Dicey Dungeons matches numbers to equipment slots; Astrea assigns effect types to targets rather than merely valuing high rolls.

combination.zh: 设计提案：用骰子代表当日食材状态，把合适的点数分给切、煮、烤步骤，坏点数也可转成备料。
combination.en: Design proposal: Represent ingredient conditions with dice assigned to cutting, boiling or baking, with awkward values usable for preparation.

setup.zh: 编辑示例：掷出二、四、六；盾牌收偶数，重击至少要五。
setup.en: Editorial example: roll two, four and six; a shield needs an even number and a heavy strike needs at least five.

action.zh: 玩家把六给重击，四给盾牌。
action.en: Assign six to the strike and four to the shield.

result.zh: 攻击与防守都成功，剩下的二还能支付一个小治疗。
result.en: Both actions work, leaving two for a minor heal.

next.zh: 下一轮重新掷骰，不能照抄这一轮分配。
next.en: The next roll requires a fresh allocation.

firstStep.zh: 用三颗六面骰和四件带简单条件的装备做单场战斗。
firstStep.en: Use three six-sided dice and four items with simple requirements in one encounter.

pitfall.zh: 首版只做一种改点能力；大量重掷、复制和锁骰会让穷举变成负担。
pitfall.en: Start with one manipulation effect; many rerolls, copies and locks can overwhelm the decision.

test.zh: 玩家能找到高点数之外的用途，并会为紧缺槽位保留合适骰子。
test.en: Players find uses beyond high values and reserve dice for constrained slots.
